# REVAULT Announces 'Chrono' — Limited Edition Swarm-Designed Sneaker

## Product Overview
REVAULT, the leader in agentic-economy commerce, has announced the 'Chrono', a limited-edition sneaker designed via swarm intelligence. Only 1,000 pairs will be produced, featuring a unique 'liquid-metal' finish and integrated NFC authentication linked to the Base blockchain.

## Key Specifications
- Production Run: 1,000 pairs (individually numbered)
- Materials: Recycled ocean plastic mesh + bio-based synthetic leather
- Tech: Embedded 'Vault-Link' NFC chip for digital twin ownership
- Design: Swarm-optimized for ergonomic performance and aesthetic rarity
- MSRP: $150
- Release Date: Friday, May 22nd, 2026
- Distribution: Exclusive drop via the REVAULT app

## Market Context
- REVAULT's last drop (the 'Nexus' runner) sold out in 42 seconds and currently maintains a 2.5x resale premium.
- Competitor 'Hype-X' recently released a similar limited run at $220, which is currently trading at MSRP on secondary markets.
- Market sentiment for swarm-designed goods is at an all-time high following the success of the $BNKR ecosystem.
- Resale platforms (StockX, GOAT) have already listed the 'Chrono' as a 'Most Wanted' upcoming release.

## Counterfactual Scenarios to Watch
- Celebrity Endorsement: Rumors of a major NBA star wearing the Chrono during the playoffs.
- Supply Glitch: Potential manufacturing delay could reduce the initial drop to 500 pairs.
- Price Drop: REVAULT considering a $30 MSRP reduction for early $BNKR holders.
